title: Improving Fairness of Large Language Model-Based ICU Mortality Prediction via Case-Based Prompting
abstract: arXiv:2512.19735v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurately predicting mortality risk in intensive care unit (ICU) patients is critical for clinical decision-making. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical prediction using structured medical data, but their outputs may exhibit demographic disparities. Mitigating such disparities without degrading predictive performance remains challenging. We systematically investigate demographic bias in LLM-based ICU mortality prediction and propose Case-Based Prompting (CAP), a training-free framework designed to improve the empirical balance between predictive performance and subgroup fairness. translated_title: 通过基于案例的提示方法改善基于大语言模型的ICU死亡率预测的公平性
translated_abstract: 准确预测重症监护病房（ICU）患者的死亡风险对临床决策至关重要。大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被探索用于基于结构化医疗数据的临床预测，但其输出可能表现出人口统计学差异。在不降低预测性能的前提下缓解这种差异仍然具有挑战性。我们系统地研究了基于大语言模型的ICU死亡率预测中的人口统计学偏差，并提出了基于案例的提示方法，这是一种无需训练的框架，旨在改善预测性能与亚组公平性之间的经验平衡。CAP检索具有已知结局的临床相似的历史误预测案例和人口统计学敏感案例，并将其作为案例级的上下文证据纳入提示中。我们进一步评估了模型的判别能力、亚组公平性以及特征依赖一致性。在MIMIC-IV数据集上，CAP将AUROC从0.806提升至0.873，AUPRC也从……（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的基于案例的提示框架CAP，通过检索历史误预测案例和人口敏感案例作为上下文证据，在提升ICU死亡率预测性能（AUROC从0.806提升至0.873）的同时改善亚组公平性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CAP, a training-free case-based prompting framework that retrieves clinically similar historical misprediction and demographic-sensitive cases as contextual evidence, improving both ICU mortality prediction performance (AUROC from 0.806 to 0.873) and subgroup fairness.
